messages:
emily-support: :rotating_light: Receiving a spike of 401s from multiple ACME prod hosts since ~08:07 UTC. Customers reporting API key invalidation errors after last night's key rotation. Ticket #4567 inbound. Anyone seen this?
raj-eng: Looking now. Can you paste a sample error and the request id?
emily-support: sample from logs: `{"ts":"2024-06-12T08:07:33Z","tenant":"acme","req_id":"req_9a8b7c","status":401,"err":"invalid_key: key not found for scope=tenant:acme"}`
emily-support: user repro curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.acme.XXX" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -v` -> 401
taylor-sre: I see auth-service errors around that time: several 504s calling kms-sync and then a backfill job started 08:05 that touched tenant-scoped keys. Might be a race where the cache served stale index while backfill was writing. Logs: `auth-backfill[pid=322]: wrote keymeta for tenant=acme version=20240612-01`
olivia-security: The rotation was scheduled last night for keyset v20240612. Backfill was intended to propagate to all zones but the job had retry jitter turned off in one region (eu-west-1) and that region timed out during KMS auth check.
raj-eng: If backfill partially succeeded, some proxy caches might have seen the new key id but the lookup service returned old mapping -> scope mismatch. Rolling key IDs without atomic switch.
emily-support: Customers want ETA and mitigation. Some are hitting 500s on retries.
taylor-sre: Short-term mitigation: enable fallback handler in auth-proxy to accept either key-id mapping for 10m while we reconcile. I can flip a feature flag. That should reduce 401 volume.
raj-eng: I can deploy a quick rollback of the backfill state — flip backfill to paused and re-queue with stricter coordination. Preparing PR to set `backfill.concurrent=1` and `kms-retry=exponential`.
deploy-bot: [08:23] Started rollout of feature-flag `auth-proxy:accept-key-fallback` to 30% -> success on canary hosts
emily-support: Confirmed reduced 401s for ACME after canary flip. Ticket update: letting customers know we have partial mitigation and working on safe backfill rollback.
olivia-security: Note: we must rotate audit keys and notify SOC once resolved. Also create temporary rate-limits to protect KMS calls during re-run.
raj-eng: Action items: 1) Pause current backfill job (in progress). 2) Reconcile missing keymeta for tenants with diff script: `scripts/keymeta-reconcile --tenant acme --dry-run` then run with `--apply`. 3) Re-run backfill with new retries + single concurrency. 4) Monitor 401 rate and traces.
taylor-sre: Reverted job -> paused. Running reconcile dry-run now. Will post results in 15m.
emily-support: Thanks team. I'll batch customer updates: initial mitigation in place, full run will take ~45-60m, escalation open to SEs if any customer still affected. :white_check_mark:
raj-eng: Reconcile dry-run shows 12 missing keymeta rows for acme. Will apply.
last message by raj-eng: Applied reconcile and re-ran backfill with conservative settings at 08:46 UTC. Monitoring. 401 rate trending down to baseline. Postmortem to follow with root cause: non-atomic keyset rotation + region-specific retry misconfig causing partial propagation.
